title: Doubled distinct partitions of type (d,tr,r): quotient shape and explicit size formulas

standard_prerequisites: Definition def:Phi (printed 18.5): the Littlewood decomposition Phi_n(lambda) = (omega, nu^(0),...,nu^(n-1)).
Definition def:psi (printed 18.1): the binary word (c_k)_{k in Z} of a partition.
Lemma lem:indices (printed 18.2): the index correspondence between zeros of the binary word and boxes.
Lemma lem:DDprimeLittlewood (printed 18.7): properties (DD'3) and (DD'4) of doubled distinct partitions under transposition.
Equation eq:motddprime (printed (6.4)): the symmetry relation c_{-k-2} = 1 - c_k of the binary word.
Equation eq:gkdd (printed (6.7)): the size identity for the doubled word used in the final derivation.
core_obligations: For n >= 2 and a doubled distinct partition of type (d,tr,r): bar-lambda belongs to C_n^{d,tr,r} if and only if nu^(j) is empty for all 0 <= j <= n-2 and nu^(n-1) is the (m-1) x m rectangle with m = max({1} union {(n+bar-lambda_i)/n | bar-lambda_i = 0 mod n}); moreover the size |bar-lambda| has the explicit formulas (6.8) in the odd case and (6.9) in the even case via the phi-map coordinates of omega.
proof_roadmap: Exclusion: if some nu^(i) with i <= n-2 is nonempty, a hook of length 1 in nu^(k) plus Lemma lem:indices and property (DD'4) of lem:DDprimeLittlewood produce a pair of indices (mn+i,(m+1)n+i) with hook length n; for i != n/2 the symmetry relation (6.4) reflects it across the diagonal, contradicting bar-lambda in C_n^{d,tr,r}; for i = n/2 the same argument confines hooks of length n to the main diagonal, and n/2 notin bar-lambda forces nu^(n/2) empty.

Rectangle: applying the same argument to the last quotient, the symmetry along the main diagonal and (DD'4) force nu^(n-1) to contain a unique box of hook length 1, hence to be an m x (m-1) rectangle, with m read off from the word as max(k+1 | c_{kn+n-1} = 0) and the explicit word display.
Size formulas: equalities (6.8) and (6.9) are derived using (6.7) and property (DD'3) of lem:DDprimeLittlewood.
difficulty_reason: 2342-2390用跨对角线的hook-length矛盾排除非末quotient，再由唯一hook逼出(m-1)x m矩形，最后结合abacus坐标给奇偶两种大小公式。分类构造有实际非例行内容。
